correctness.rationale: PASS: Gaussian E[gg^T]=I and E[(gg^T)^2]=(d+2)I reconstruct the exact 3x3 map on (E||x_k||^2,E<x_k,x_{k-1}>,E||x_{k-1}||^2). The induced positive-semidefinite Gram map satisfies det Gnext=omega^2 det G+(d+1)alpha^2 G11^2; for omega>0, 1–2 updates move nonzero PSD to its interior, ensuring primitive-cone Perron growth and a nonzero leading coefficient for any nonzero zero-momentum initialization. For omega=0 direct scalar factor applies. P(1)=alpha[2(1-omega^2)-alpha(d(1+omega)+2)] and det M=omega^3 yield iff strict stability (omega<1, alpha below ceiling). Completing the square for P((d+1)/(d+2)) makes its sign strictly negative except at omega=0, alpha=1/(d+2), proving unique global optimal rate. Independently recomputed polynomials and 64 rational spectral boundary checks, not extrapolated as proof.
